qa_pair.question: In the frozen evaluation fixture, among Active skills in Interface kit that are absent from the laptop inventory, which has the largest install count? Answer with the skill name.
In the frozen evaluation fixture, which skill belongs to both Release kit and Interface kit and appears in both the laptop and desktop inventories? Answer with the skill name.
In the frozen evaluation fixture, which skill in the laptop inventory but not the desktop inventory carries the Security tag? Answer with the skill name.
In the frozen evaluation fixture, inspect the skills in the laptop inventory but not the desktop inventory. Which has the largest install count? Answer with the skill name.
In the frozen evaluation fixture, how many liked Backend-tagged skills are installed only on the laptop machine? Answer with an integer.
In the frozen evaluation fixture, find the unliked skill in Interface kit that appears in an environment with an incomplete scan. What are its exact personal shelf notes?
In the frozen evaluation fixture, which Release kit skill has no recorded environment installation? Answer with the skill name.
In the frozen evaluation fixture, find the skill present in every environment whose scan is complete. Is that skill liked on the personal shelf? Answer True or False.
In the frozen evaluation fixture, one skill is in the desktop inventory but not the laptop inventory. Which accessible list contains that skill? Answer with the list name.
In the frozen evaluation fixture, add the install counts of all skills in the laptop inventory but not the desktop inventory. What is the total? Answer with an integer.
